title: Nonzero polynomial formal fibres in characteristic zero
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian complete local domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] with fraction field [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] of characteristic zero, $q$ a maximal ideal of $A[x]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] contracting to the maximal ideal of $A$, and $0\ne r\subseteq q$ a prime contracting to zero in $A$. Then $\kappa(r)\otimes_{A[x]}(A[x]_q)^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is geometrically regular over $\kappa(r)$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.place: Proof of Proposition 07PV, paragraphs 3--4, nonzero characteristic-zero case; derivation repair from the second paragraph of the proof of Lemma 07PU, using 07PE and 07PF.

proof.text: Eliminate the regular complete local subring reduction, install its ring and prime instances, and prove its regular formal fibre by the regular-base theorem. Apply the transfer implication to obtain the unchanged conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem completeLocalNonzeroFibreCharZero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsMaximal]
    (hq : q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    [CharZero (Localization.AtPrime (⊥ : Ideal A))]
    (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q) (hr : r ≠ ⊥)
    (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) :
    Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular r.ResidueField
      (r.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))
        (Localization.AtPrime q)))
